elements.description:
A pause before relying on an answer: intent, prior, reformulate or checkpoint prompts, submitted through a
cancelable event.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Which prompt to show: intent, prior, reformulate or checkpoint

properties.name: phase
properties.description: Where the gate is: open, compare (reformulate's second step), done or skipped – set it to restore one

properties.name: value
properties.description: What the person wrote or picked, by field

properties.name: answer
properties.description: The answer – hidden in prior mode until the prior is in, shown to restate in reformulate mode

properties.name: claims
properties.description: The claims to pick from in checkpoint mode; without them the person types the claim

properties.name: allowSkip
properties.description: Shows Skip – only where your product lets people go on without reflecting

properties.name: minWords
properties.description: The fewest words a restatement may have

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading – defaults to the mode's

properties.name: description
properties.description: The line under the heading – defaults to the mode's

properties.name: brief
properties.description: The short version for deadline situations: one combined field per mode, marked as the short version, still recorded

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Any of the gate's texts, to change the wording or the language

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The person edited a field; detail `{ value }`: ReflectionGateValueChange. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-submit
events.description: The mode's fields passed their checks; detail `{ mode, value }`: ReflectionGateSubmission. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the gate open.

events.name: tc-skip
events.description: Skip was pressed (only with `allow-skip`); detail `{ mode }`: ReflectionGateSkip. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-phase-change
events.description: The gate moves on – to compare, done, skipped, or back to open; detail `{ phase }`: ReflectionGatePhaseChange. Cancelable.

functions.name: missingTerms
functions.description:
The answer's key terms that a restatement doesn't mention: numbers, amounts and dates, and longer words that
aren't filler – lower-cased, once each, in the answer's order.

props.name: mode
props.description: Which prompt to show: intent, prior, reformulate or checkpoint

props.name: value
props.description: What the person wrote or picked (controlled). Leave it undefined to let the gate keep it, starting at `defaultValue`

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: What the fields hold at first when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with every edit, controlled or not

props.name: phase
props.description: Where the gate is (controlled): open, compare, done or skipped. Leave it undefined to let the gate move on its own

props.name: defaultPhase
props.description: The phase at first when uncontrolled – e.g. "done" for a reflection already on record

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Called whenever the gate moves on, controlled or not

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the mode's fields once they pass their checks; return false to keep the gate open

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Shows Skip and is called when it's pressed; return false to keep the gate open. Leave it out where skipping isn't allowed

props.name: title
props.description: The heading – defaults to the mode's

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - claims and their reliability: `tc-claim-answer`, `tc-verification-queue`, `tc-reflection-gate`, `tc-reliance-gauge`, `tc-disagreement-banner`, `tc-synthesis-notes`; - where outputs came from: `tc-lineage-graph`, `tc-validity-badge`, `tc-provenance-summary`, `tc-correction-propagation`, `tc-attestation-check`, `tc-run-manifest`; - policy and control: `tc-policy-simulator`, `tc-gate-config`, `tc-coverage-matrix`, `tc-kill-switch`, `tc-playbook-canvas`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: field-sizing
features.without: Text fields grow with their text. Without it they keep their minimum height and scroll.

features.name: text-wrap: pretty
features.without: Paragraphs may end on a single short word.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
